Box 948, West Plains, MO 65775) handles cancellations, billing-information updates and replacement cards. Memberships are non-refundable and non-transferable.

entries.name: KerixHealth (formerly Nextera Healthcare) direct primary care
entries.service_area_detail: Direct & advanced primary care clinics (Colorado origin) for individuals and employers
entries.senior_programs: Flat monthly fee; no copays for primary care.
entries.notes: FAQ: after the initial period you may cancel any time with 30 days' notice through your account portal; already-paid fees not refunded or prorated. Medicare eligibility depends on the clinician (physicians must opt out of Medicare to offer DPC). MEDICARE: Direct primary care (DPC) practices usually do not bill insurance; to accept a DPC fee from a Medicare patient the physician typically must opt out of Medicare, so neither the DPC fee nor visits there are paid by Medicare, and the patient signs a private contract. The patient keeps Medicare (Part A/B/D and any Medigap/Advantage) for specialists, hospitals, labs and imaging outside the practice. Since 2026 (2025 law) DPC fees up to $150/month individual can be paid from an HSA, but people enrolled in Medicare cannot contribute to an HSA. flat monthly fee varying by location; new memberships must stay active 3 months, then cancel any time with 30 days notice through the account portal; paid fees are not refunded or prorated. HSA debit cards eligible from Jan 1, 2026. MEDICARE: participating physicians must opt out of Medicare to offer DPC to Medicare patients; you keep Medicare but those doctors cannot bill it, so Medicare will not pay for their visits. The FAQ page covers cancelling (30 days' notice through your account portal after the initial period; paid fees are not refunded or prorated) and HSA use: from January 1, 2026 HSAs can pay for direct primary care; pay with an HSA debit card at sign-up or pay out of pocket and submit your KerixHealth receipt to your HSA administrator. Labs, imaging, specialists, ER and hospital care need separate coverage.

entries.senior_programs: 2026 fees $89 single / $133 family. Covers deductibles and copays for medically necessary Sunstar transports within Pinellas County; uninsured members get 20% off. No cards issued.
entries.notes: Covers 100% of deductibles and copays and 50% of medically necessary trips insurance denies; uninsured members get 20% off. Applications at pinellas.gov/firstcare; must be received before year-end for a Jan 1 start. Ambulance bills: https://pinellas.gov/services/pay-an-ambulance-bill/ (Sunstar bill pay https://pay.bill2pay.com/client/PNLSEMS). A large senior population makes this one of the biggest county programs in Florida. MEDICARE: Part B covers medically necessary emergency ground ambulance (80% of the approved amount after the Part B deductible; non-emergency trips only with a doctor's certification); Medigap usually pays the 20%. The federal No Surprises Act does NOT protect against ground-ambulance balance bills. Medicare, Medigap and Medicare Advantage do NOT pay or reimburse the subscription fee itself; a subscription mainly helps people with no Medigap, high Advantage copays, or trips Medicare denies. Medicaid enrollees generally cannot or need not join. FirstCare apply online (application page above), by phone, or mail with check/money order. Membership year runs April 1 - March 31; renewals must be postmarked before April 1 to avoid a gap; new applications after Jan 1, 2027 are not accepted for the current year. No automatic renewal; renew yearly. FAQ: memberships run April 1 to March 31; renewal applications must be postmarked before April 1 to avoid a gap. Pay online at https://pay.bill2pay.com/client/PNLSEMS (card fee $5 family / $2.50 single) or mail to 12490 Ulmerton Road, Largo, FL 33774. No membership cards are issued: your check or card statement is your receipt. Fees are non-refundable if you cancel, except refunds may be possible before the effective date for a death in the family or other extenuating circumstances.

entries.senior_programs: $99/yr per household; $79/yr for seniors over 60.
entries.notes: CANCEL/BILLING: the AMCN support page (https://www.airmedcarenetwork.com/support) has a contact form with topics 'I would like to cancel my membership', 'I need to update my personal/billing info' and 'I need replacement membership cards'; member services also at https://www.airmedcarenetwork.com/member-services-guide and 833-819-3454. Hawaii brand page for the AirMedCare Network membership; new memberships start 15 days after the paid application. Billing, renewal and cancel work as for other AMCN brands. MEDICARE: Part B covers emergency air ambulance only when ground transport would endanger the patient (80% after the deductible). Since 2022 the No Surprises Act caps out-of-network AIR ambulance cost-sharing at in-network levels for private/group plans, which reduces the value of air memberships for many people; Medicare does not pay the membership fee. Confirm auto-renew status and cancel via the support form or 833-819-3454. Standard AMCN terms: memberships are non-refundable except state-specific rules (Wyoming 30-day full refund and pro-rated after; Alaska 15-day cancel window). Renew on the AirMedCare Network 'Renew membership' page. The AMCN Support page (833-819-3454; P.O. Box 948, West Plains, MO 65775) handles cancellations, billing-information updates and replacement cards. Memberships are non-refundable and non-transferable.

entries.name: Ada County Paramedics Vital Ride Ambulance Membership (Boise, ID)
entries.service_area_detail: Ada County (Boise, Meridian, Eagle, Kuna)
entries.payment_processor: Ada County online sign-up; transport bills via emspatient.com
entries.senior_programs: 1-year $75, 5-year $280, lifetime $1,000; 5% off for veterans/active military/first responders; 10% off groups of 5+.
entries.notes: Multi-year and lifetime options avoid annual renewals. Pay an ambulance bill: https://adacounty.id.gov/paramedics/pay-ambulance-bill/. MEDICARE: Part B covers medically necessary emergency ground ambulance (80% of the approved amount after the Part B deductible; non-emergency trips only with a doctor's certification); Medigap usually pays the 20%. The federal No Surprises Act does NOT protect against ground-ambulance balance bills. Medicare, Medigap and Medicare Advantage do NOT pay or reimburse the subscription fee itself; a subscription mainly helps people with no Medigap, high Advantage copays, or trips Medicare denies. Medicaid enrollees generally cannot or need not join. Renewal notices mailed 45 and 15 days before expiration (no auto-renew); covers the member plus tax dependents and spouse; checks payable to Ada County Paramedics. Members are invoiced after a transport while Ada County bills insurance, then the remaining balance is waived; if insurance paid more than $150 and you still get an invoice, contact Ada County Paramedics. Sign-up terms: fees are non-refundable and non-transferable, and either party can cancel the membership at any time.

MEDICARE: Part B covers medically necessary emergency air ambulance (80% of the approved amount after the Part B deductible); Medigap or a Medicare Advantage plan usually covers most of the rest, and the federal No Surprises Act (2022) bars out-of-network air-ambulance balance billing for insured patients. Medicare does NOT pay for or reimburse the membership fee. Memberships are not insurance and Medicaid enrollees generally may not buy them. St. Luke's financial assistance can help with emergency or medically necessary care bills (including flights) for qualifying patients who live in Idaho, Oregon or Nevada service areas.

entries.service_area_detail: Linn County, Kansas
entries.notes: Application: https://www.amr.net/locations/kansas/linn-county/lifecare-membership-program/documents/lifecare-membership-program-application. MEDICARE: Part B covers medically necessary emergency ground ambulance (80% of the approved amount after the Part B deductible; non-emergency trips only with a doctor's certification); Medigap usually pays the 20%. The federal No Surprises Act does NOT protect against ground-ambulance balance bills. Medicare, Medigap and Medicare Advantage do NOT pay or reimburse the subscription fee itself; a subscription mainly helps people with no Medigap, high Advantage copays, or trips Medicare denies. Medicaid enrollees generally cannot or need not join. Accepted applicants receive a LifeCare membership card showing the membership number and plan expiration date; there is no automatic renewal, so renew by phone or mailed application before the date on the card. AMR billing questions: 800-913-9106.

entries.name: Acadian Ambulance Membership (My Acadian)
entries.service_area_detail: Acadian Ambulance service area in Louisiana, Mississippi and Texas; annual coverage period Sept 1 - Aug 31
entries.phone_pay_by_phone: 1-800-256-5646 (card by phone, $2.00 handling fee)
entries.mail_payment_address: Acadian Ambulance, Membership Department, PO Box 919285, Dallas, TX 75391-9285
entries.senior_programs: $84/yr standard membership (individual or family: applicant, spouse/partner, children to 26). 65% of members are 62+ Medicare recipients. Also 10% off Acadian On Call medical-alert monitoring.
entries.notes: Join/Renew: https://www.myacadian.com/join/CheckoutStepOne.aspx (online, no fee); phone orders by check or card ($2 fee); mail orders by check/money order/card using form from https://acadian.com/membershipforms/. Benefit is a 30% discount on billed ambulance charges in the service area. Texas and Mississippi Medicaid recipients may not buy; Louisiana Medicaid recipients may. Annual campaign has a join deadline (see FAQ). Transport bills: https://acadianambulance.com/patient-portal/. MEDICARE: Part B covers medically necessary emergency ground ambulance (80% after the Part B deductible; non-emergency trips only with a doctor's certification). Federal No Surprises Act balance-billing protection does NOT apply to ground ambulances, which is what these subscriptions cover (some states have their own laws). Medicare does NOT pay or reimburse the subscription fee. Medicaid enrollees generally may not buy these subscriptions. $84 per household for the Sept 1, 2026 - Aug 31, 2027 term, not prorated; enroll by Sept 11 deadline noted; pay online at acadian.com/membershippayment (no fee) or by phone ($2 fee). Texas and Mississippi Medicaid recipients are ineligible; Louisiana Medicaid recipients may buy. No auto-renewal or cancellation language published. Membership FAQ: the coverage period is Sept. 1, 2026 through Aug. 31, 2027 ($84 individual or family); memberships are not prorated, even if bought after the campaign. Pay online at acadian.com/membershippayment (no fee), by phone ($2 handling fee) at 1-800-256-5646 or 337-521-3401 (M-F 8-5), or by mail to Membership Department, PO Box 919285, Dallas, TX 75391-9285. Texas and Mississippi Medicaid recipients cannot buy a membership; Louisiana Medicaid recipients can.

entries.name: Emergent Health Partners Member Plus (Huron Valley, Jackson, Monroe, Lenawee, Albion ambulances, MI)
entries.service_area_detail: Southern Michigan: Huron Valley Ambulance (Ann Arbor area), Jackson, Monroe, Lenawee and Albion Community Ambulance, LifeCare Ambulance (Battle Creek area)
entries.payment_processor: Online sign-up on emergenthealth.org; print-and-mail brochure application
entries.senior_programs: $75 per year covers you and dependents; site says it suits seniors without supplemental insurance.
entries.notes: Join any time; membership lasts 12 months from receipt of payment and can be renewed any time. Print/mail application: https://www.emergenthealth.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/202410_Member-Plus-Brochure-full.pdf. Phone numbers on the page include 734-477-6783 and 269-964-6400 (LifeCare); confirm which handles memberships. MEDICARE: Part B covers medically necessary emergency ground ambulance (80% of the approved amount after the Part B deductible; non-emergency trips only with a doctor's certification); Medigap usually pays the 20%. The federal No Surprises Act does NOT protect against ground-ambulance balance bills. Medicare, Medigap and Medicare Advantage do NOT pay or reimburse the subscription fee itself; a subscription mainly helps people with no Medigap, high Advantage copays, or trips Medicare denies. Medicaid enrollees generally cannot or need not join.

entries.name: Plum Health DPC (Detroit, MI)
entries.service_area_detail: Detroit-area direct primary care
entries.senior_programs: $95/month single; $180 member + spouse/child; $270 family. Cash-priced labs and medications.
entries.notes: Monthly DPC membership; no insurance billed. MEDICARE: Direct primary care (DPC) practices usually do not bill insurance; to accept a DPC fee from a Medicare patient the physician typically must opt out of Medicare, so neither the DPC fee nor visits there are paid by Medicare, and the patient signs a private contract. The patient keeps Medicare (Part A/B/D and any Medigap/Advantage) for specialists, hospitals, labs and imaging outside the practice. Since 2026 (2025 law) DPC fees up to $150/month individual can be paid from an HSA, but people enrolled in Medicare cannot contribute to an HSA.

entries.name: Duke Signature Care (Duke Health concierge primary care)
entries.service_area_detail: Duke Center for Living Campus, 3475 Erwin Rd, Durham NC
entries.notes: Concierge primary care for an annual fee; accepts Medicare and Medicare Advantage plans for covered services (insurance list on page). Annual-fee billing handled by the practice; medical bills via Duke MyChart. MEDICARE: Most concierge physicians stay enrolled in Medicare and bill Medicare/your Medigap or Advantage plan for covered visits, labs and tests as usual. The membership (retainer) fee pays for non-covered extras (longer annual wellness program, access, care coordination) and is NOT covered or reimbursed by Medicare, Medigap or Medicare Advantage. Medicare rules forbid charging the fee for Medicare-covered services themselves. Medical bills (not the annual fee) are due 15 days after you receive them: pay in My Duke Health (MyChart), by mail with a check using the statement instructions, or by phone; caregivers can pay as a guest without an account and review payment history. Duke Customer Service: 919-620-4555 or 1-800-782-6945. The annual concierge fee is billed by the practice; call 919-660-6746.

entries.name: Wake County EMS $60 Subscription Program (Raleigh, NC)
entries.service_area_detail: All of Wake County; calendar-year subscription
entries.senior_programs: $60 per household per year; requires private insurance or Medicare.
entries.notes: Join online (activation code WAKE) or call 844-239-6690. Sign-up for the next year opens Nov 1; current members get renewal notices in the fall. Terms: https://www.wake.gov/departments-government/emergency-medical-services-ems/60-subscription-program/terms-and-conditions-60-subscription-program. MEDICARE: Part B covers medically necessary emergency ground ambulance (80% of the approved amount after the Part B deductible; non-emergency trips only with a doctor's certification); Medigap usually pays the 20%. The federal No Surprises Act does NOT protect against ground-ambulance balance bills. Medicare, Medigap and Medicare Advantage do NOT pay or reimburse the subscription fee itself; a subscription mainly helps people with no Medigap, high Advantage copays, or trips Medicare denies. Medicaid enrollees generally cannot or need not join. $60/yr per household; coverage starts two days after payment and ends Dec 31; new sign-ups from Nov 1; current members get renewal notices in the fall (no auto-renew described); emergency 911 transports by Wake County EMS only, not air or non-emergency. Coverage begins two days after payment is received and ends December 31; renewal notices for the next year are mailed in the fall (no automatic renewal). Terms and Conditions: the subscription is non-refundable and non-transferable, does not apply to people without insurance or on Medicaid, and subscribers must forward any insurance payments they receive to Wake County EMS.

entries.name: Storey County Fire Ambulance Subscription Program (Virginia City, NV)
entries.service_area_detail: Storey County (Virginia City, Lockwood, Mark Twain, TRI Center)
entries.senior_programs: $75 single-subscriber household; $125 households with two or more subscribers (2024-25 rates on page).
entries.notes: New subscriptions and renewals through the EMSecurePay member portal (needs the activation code given by the district). Questions: dedicated membership line 775-847-0954. Ambulance bills: https://storeyfire.org/ambulance-billing. MEDICARE: Part B covers medically necessary emergency ground ambulance (80% of the approved amount after the Part B deductible; non-emergency trips only with a doctor's certification); Medigap usually pays the 20%. The federal No Surprises Act does NOT protect against ground-ambulance balance bills. Medicare, Medigap and Medicare Advantage do NOT pay or reimburse the subscription fee itself; a subscription mainly helps people with no Medigap, high Advantage copays, or trips Medicare denies. Medicaid enrollees generally cannot or need not join. $75 single-subscriber household / $125 two or more; renew online (EMSecurePay) or email the PDF form to fire@storeycounty.org; excludes nursing/convalescent home residents and people with unpaid past bills. The page text names the "Central Lyon County Fire Protection District service area", which looks like copied wording; confirm coverage area at 775-847-0954. Log in to the EMSecurePay member portal (first time: use 'Have you enrolled before?' with the activation code from the district) to renew or check your subscription.

entries.name: REMSA Health Membership Plus / Care Flight / Sierra Saver (Reno NV)
entries.service_area_detail: Washoe County NV ground (REMSA); Care Flight air over ~50,000 sq mi of NV/CA; Sierra Saver ground plan in Plumas County CA
entries.senior_programs: Premier (ground + air, household) $130/yr; REMSA ground (Washoe only) $90/yr; Care Flight air $75/yr; Sierra Saver (Plumas County ground) $69/yr per household.
entries.notes: Membership Log In and Sign Up are on the Membership Plus page; Sierra Saver signup via https://remsa.formstack.com/forms/membershipform_sierrasaver. Terms: https://www.remsahealth.com/membership-plus-terms-conditions-2/. Care Flight package is part of the AAMMP reciprocal network. Transport billing: https://www.remsahealth.com/billing-services/. MEDICARE: Part B covers medically necessary emergency air ambulance (80% of the approved amount after the Part B deductible); Medigap or a Medicare Advantage plan usually covers most of the rest, and the federal No Surprises Act (2022) bars out-of-network air-ambulance balance billing for insured patients. Medicare does NOT pay for or reimburse the membership fee. Memberships are not insurance and Medicaid enrollees generally may not buy them. Ground part: MEDICARE: Part B covers medically necessary emergency ground ambulance (80% after the Part B deductible; non-emergency trips only with a doctor's certification). Federal No Surprises Act balance-billing protection does NOT apply to ground ambulances, which is what these subscriptions cover (some states have their own laws). Medicare does NOT pay or reimburse the subscription fee. Medicaid enrollees generally may not buy these subscriptions. Premier $130/yr (ground + regional air, Washoe County household), REMSA Health ground $90, Care Flight air $75, Sierra Saver (Plumas County) $69 via https://remsa.formstack.com/forms/membershipform_sierrasaver. Sign up https://web.remsahealth.com/atlas/forms/1. No auto-renew/cancel terms on the page. Terms and Conditions page: the member may cancel a package at any time, memberships are non-transferable and non-refundable, coverage is for the household listed on the application (including a Nevada nursing home), and members get a 30% discount on non-covered services. Signing up means agreeing to membership calls, emails and texts. To cancel, call membership at 775-858-5745.

entries.name: Sollis Health (24/7 concierge urgent-care membership)
entries.service_area_detail: Members-only 24/7 medical centers (New York, Los Angeles, Palm Beach and other metros)
entries.phone_customer_service: NY/Hamptons (646) 687-7600; Southern CA (310) 870-0400; Northern CA (415) 233-9901; South Florida (561) 560-7600; sollismembership@sollishealth.com
entries.notes: FAQ addresses monthly payment of the membership fee and what is included; member page: https://www.sollishealth.com/for-members. contact membership email. MEDICARE: Most concierge physicians stay enrolled in Medicare and bill Medicare/your Medigap or Advantage plan for covered visits, labs and tests as usual. The membership (retainer) fee pays for non-covered extras (longer annual wellness program, access, care coordination) and is NOT covered or reimbursed by Medicare, Medigap or Medicare Advantage. Medicare rules forbid charging the fee for Medicare-covered services themselves. Sollis uses age-based pricing; the FAQ answers whether the fee can be paid monthly, seasonal memberships, adding a family member mid-year and FSA/HSA use. For billing, renewals or cancellation email sollismembership@sollishealth.com or call (646) 687-7600.

entries.name: MedFlight Advantage / Advantage Global Membership (Ohio)
entries.parent_company: MedFlight of Ohio (nonprofit; with MedCare Ambulance and AirMed)
entries.service_area_detail: MedFlight service territory in central/southern Ohio (Advantage); Advantage Global adds jet transport anywhere in the US and abroad
entries.senior_programs: Advantage $69.99/yr per household; Advantage Global $269.99 individual / $369.99 family. Eligibility: Ohio residents 18 to 75 (Global: US residents, same age limit), so people over 75 cannot newly enroll.
entries.notes: Sign up: https://medflightadvantage.medflight.com/enrollment/enrollment.aspx; renew in the member portal. Covers helicopter, mobile ICU and MedCare ground ambulance. Memberships include automatic 'no-hassle' renewal; to turn it off or cancel call 1-855-632-3884 (Mon-Fri 8-5 ET); Benefits start 72 hours after payment. Medicaid recipients are not eligible; uninsured members get 50% off. Earlier passes recorded MedFlight as having no consumer membership, but this page shows one. MEDICARE: Part B covers emergency air ambulance only when ground transport would endanger the patient (80% after the deductible). Since 2022 the No Surprises Act caps out-of-network AIR ambulance cost-sharing at in-network levels for private/group plans, which reduces the value of air memberships for many people; Medicare does not pay the membership fee. $69.99/yr Advantage (Ohio residents 18-75), Global $269.99 individual / $369.99 family (US residents 18-75); "automatic no-hassle renewal"; benefits start 72 hours after payment. Receipts: if you cannot print one from the portal, email membership@medflight.com. Phone 1-855-632-3884 M-F 8am-5pm ET. To cancel or stop auto-renewal, call or email membership. Medicaid recipients are ineligible. Members over 75 cannot buy this product. If you cannot print your receipt, email membership@medflight.com and a membership specialist will send a copy. Ohio residents 18 to 75 can join; benefits continue through the benefit year if you enrolled before 75, but renewal is not available afterward. Medicaid recipients are not eligible because coverage is redundant.

entries.name: City of Edmond Ambulance Transport Program (Edmond, OK)
entries.service_area_detail: City of Edmond residential utility customers (auto-enrolled)
entries.payment_processor: City of Edmond utility bill (fee added monthly)
entries.senior_programs: Fee on the city utility bill (about $3/month per FAQ).
entries.notes: Edmond utility customers are automatically enrolled in the AMR ground ambulance program and pay on the city utility bill; opt out by contacting Utility Customer Service 405-359-4541 (enrollment lasts at least a year). Non-utility customers can buy a membership directly from AMR (FAQ https://www.edmondok.gov/Faq.aspx?QID=649). Reimbursement claims: https://www.edmondok.gov/FormCenter/Utility-Customer-Service-21/Ambulance-Transport-Reimbursement-253. MEDICARE: Part B covers medically necessary emergency ground ambulance (80% of the approved amount after the Part B deductible; non-emergency trips only with a doctor's certification); Medigap usually pays the 20%. The federal No Surprises Act does NOT protect against ground-ambulance balance bills. Medicare, Medigap and Medicare Advantage do NOT pay or reimburse the subscription fee itself; a subscription mainly helps people with no Medigap, high Advantage copays, or trips Medicare denies. Medicaid enrollees generally cannot or need not join. Residential utility customers are automatically enrolled and the fee is billed each month on the city utility bill (covers up to two emergency AMR transports per year for the household). The program page explains how to opt in or opt out: call Utility Customer Service at (405) 359-4541 or email them.

entries.name: EMSAcare (formerly TotalCare) - EMSA Oklahoma City & Tulsa ambulance membership
entries.parent_company: Emergency Medical Services Authority (EMSA), public trust
entries.service_area_detail: Oklahoma City, Tulsa, Jenks, Nichols Hills, The Village, Arcadia, Valley Brook, Lake Aluma
entries.payment_processor: City utility bill (auto-enrolled) or EMSA express checkout
entries.senior_programs: Utility-bill program: $5.45/month (Tulsa area) or $3.65/month (OKC area). Direct annual enrollment: $65/yr (Tulsa/Eastern) or $45/yr (OKC/Western). Covers all permanent household residents for copays/deductibles after emergency transport and (from Oct 1, 2026) Treatment-in-Place.
entries.notes: In participating cities residents are auto-enrolled through the city water/utility bill; opt-out/opt-in windows are August (Tulsa area) and September (OKC area). Utility-bill participants stay covered automatically; direct subscribers renew annually via express checkout. To cancel the utility-bill charge, opt out during the annual window (see EMSAcare page). MEDICARE: Part B covers medically necessary emergency ground ambulance (80% after the Part B deductible; non-emergency trips only with a doctor's certification). Federal No Surprises Act balance-billing protection does NOT apply to ground ambulances, which is what these subscriptions cover (some states have their own laws). Medicare does NOT pay or reimburse the subscription fee. Medicaid enrollees generally may not buy these subscriptions. Utility-bill fee $5.45/mo (Tulsa area) or $3.65/mo (OKC area); direct annual $65 (Tulsa/Eastern) or $45 (OKC/Western). Participating utility cities include Tulsa, Oklahoma City, Jenks, Nichols Hills, The Village, Arcadia, Valley Brook, Lake Aluma. Opt-in/out windows: August (Tulsa) and September (OKC). Uninsured patients get 40% off transport charges from Oct 1, 2026. The EMSAcare page has a 'Check My Coverage' tool. From October 1, 2026, members also pay nothing out of pocket when EMSA treats them at home without transport.

entries.name: TowerDIRECT Ambulance Membership (Tower Health, Berks/Chester/Montgomery, PA)
entries.service_area_detail: Tower Health ambulance areas around Reading, Pottstown and Phoenixville
entries.senior_programs: Senior (62+) rates: $65 individual, $100 household per year; standard (under 62): $75 individual, $110 household.
entries.notes: Join with the online form or call 484-628-4493 for a paper form. Hospital/transport bills: https://towerhealth.org/pay-my-bill. MEDICARE: Part B covers medically necessary emergency ground ambulance (80% of the approved amount after the Part B deductible; non-emergency trips only with a doctor's certification); Medigap usually pays the 20%. The federal No Surprises Act does NOT protect against ground-ambulance balance bills. Medicare, Medigap and Medicare Advantage do NOT pay or reimburse the subscription fee itself; a subscription mainly helps people with no Medigap, high Advantage copays, or trips Medicare denies. Medicaid enrollees generally cannot or need not join. Tower Health financial assistance applications (several languages) can help with hospital and transport bills.

entries.name: Tri-Community South EMS Subscription (Allegheny County, PA)
entries.service_area_detail: South Hills communities of Allegheny County served by Tri-Community South EMS
entries.senior_programs: $70 individual / $90 household per year; 50% off out-of-pocket for emergency transports (lift assists and non-transport not covered).
entries.notes: Subscription notices emailed/mailed each October; pay by credit card online. FAQs: https://www.tcsems.org/subscriptions___billing/faqs.php; transport bills: https://tcsems.payambulance.com/. MEDICARE: Part B covers medically necessary emergency ground ambulance (80% after the Part B deductible; non-emergency trips only with a doctor's certification). Federal No Surprises Act balance-billing protection does NOT apply to ground ambulances, which is what these subscriptions cover (some states have their own laws). Medicare does NOT pay or reimburse the subscription fee. Medicaid enrollees generally may not buy these subscriptions. Subscription notices are emailed and/or mailed to every household in October; when you log in online you choose the subscription year. There is no automatic renewal. Ambulance bills are handled by Digitech: 833-532-2199, TCSEMS@PayAmbulance.com, or pay at https://tcsems.payambulance.com.

entries.name: CareFlite Caring Hearts Membership (North Texas air + ground)
entries.parent_company: CareFlite (nonprofit; joint venture of 5 hospital systems)
entries.service_area_detail: CareFlite helicopter and ground ambulance service area (Dallas-Fort Worth / North Texas)
entries.phone_customer_service: (972) 339-4243 (membership); membership@careflite.org
entries.senior_programs: $79/yr per household; $49/yr military/first responder. Underinsured/private-pay members get 50% off charges.
entries.notes: Auto-renewal is opt-in: the membership agreement on the membership page says the member must reapply at term end unless the automatic-renewal box is checked (same page for setup; contact membership to stop). Join/renew and manage membership in the eServices membership portal. Membership effective on the date of application and payment; members must keep insurance and dependent info current. CareFlite accepts insurance payment as payment in full for members. Transport bills (not membership) are paid at https://admin.eservicestech.com/expresspay/careflite. MEDICARE: Part B covers medically necessary emergency air ambulance (80% of the approved amount after the Part B deductible); Medigap or a Medicare Advantage plan usually covers most of the rest, and the federal No Surprises Act (2022) bars out-of-network air-ambulance balance billing for insured patients. Medicare does NOT pay for or reimburse the membership fee. Memberships are not insurance and Medicaid enrollees generally may not buy them. Ground part: MEDICARE: Part B covers medically necessary emergency ground ambulance (80% after the Part B deductible; non-emergency trips only with a doctor's certification). Federal No Surprises Act balance-billing protection does NOT apply to ground ambulances, which is what these subscriptions cover (some states have their own laws). Medicare does NOT pay or reimburse the subscription fee. Medicaid enrollees generally may not buy these subscriptions. Ambulance transport bills (separate from the membership fee) are paid at https://admin.eservicestech.com/expresspay/careflite. CareFlite has a Charity Care Application (linked on its Contact page) for patients who cannot pay a transport bill.

MEDICARE: Part B covers medically necessary emergency air ambulance (80% of the approved amount after the Part B deductible); Medigap or a Medicare Advantage plan usually covers most of the rest, and the federal No Surprises Act (2022) bars out-of-network air-ambulance balance billing for insured patients. One membership covers everyone at the same primary residence, including students away at school; members 60+ get the senior household price and there is no annual cap on transports. Memberships are non-refundable and non-transferable. Medicaid usually pays air ambulance in full, so Medicaid enrollees generally do not need a membership.

entries.name: Guardian Flight membership (AirMedCare Network)
entries.service_area_detail: GMR air-ambulance brand; membership honored across AMCN providers (~320 bases in 38 states)
entries.phone_customer_service: Membership 800-793-0010; patient accounts 801-938-8200; AirMedCare Network site contact 833-819-3454
entries.mail_payment_address: AirMedCare Network, P.O. Box 948, West Plains, MO 65775
entries.senior_programs: $79/yr seniors over 60 (household); standard $99/yr.
entries.notes: CANCEL/BILLING: the AMCN support page (https://www.airmedcarenetwork.com/support) has a contact form with topics 'I would like to cancel my membership', 'I need to update my personal/billing info' and 'I need replacement membership cards'; member services also at https://www.airmedcarenetwork.com/member-services-guide and 833-819-3454. Brand-level pointer: this provider's membership IS an AirMedCare Network (AMCN) membership. Provider page states $99/yr per household, $79/yr for seniors over 60; new memberships start 15 days after completed application and payment. Membership questions: 800-793-0010 or amcn.questions@gmr.net (per Guardian Flight contact block). AMCN terms list 1/3/5/10-year terms and a MONTHLY option ($9/month standard or senior/affinity; $14.99 Fly-U-Home), so monthly members have a recurring charge; annual senior rate $79, 10-year senior $589. Memberships are non-refundable except state exceptions (e.g., Alaska 15-day withdrawal, Wyoming pro-rated cancellation). AMCN footer: alliance of Air Evac Lifeteam, Guardian Flight, Med-Trans and REACH. AMCN FAQ says Medicaid usually pays air ambulance in full and members certify they are not Medicaid beneficiaries. To cancel, use the AirMedCare Network Support page form or call. MEDICARE: Part B covers medically necessary emergency air ambulance (80% of the approved amount after the Part B deductible); Medigap or a Medicare Advantage plan usually covers most of the rest, and the federal No Surprises Act (2022) bars out-of-network air-ambulance balance billing for insured patients. Medicare does NOT pay for or reimburse the membership fee. Memberships are not insurance and Medicaid enrollees generally may not buy them. Confirm auto-renew status and cancel via the support form or 833-819-3454. Standard AMCN terms: memberships are non-refundable except state-specific rules (Wyoming 30-day full refund and pro-rated after; Alaska 15-day cancel window). Renew an existing membership on the AirMedCare Network 'Renew membership' page. The Support page (phone 833-819-3454; mail P.O. Box 948, West Plains, MO 65775) has a message form with topics for cancelling a membership, updating personal or billing information, and replacement cards. One membership covers everyone at the same primary residence, including students away at school; members 60+ get the senior household price and there is no annual cap on transports. Memberships are non-refundable and non-transferable. Medicaid usually pays air ambulance in full, so Medicaid enrollees generally do not need a membership.

entries.name: Hint Health (membership billing platform used by direct primary care practices)

entries.notes: If a senior sees a recurring charge from 'Hint' or a practice name via Hint, it is usually a direct-primary-care membership fee billed by that practice. Hint supports patient-paid memberships, invoicing and point-of-sale for practices; to change payment, get receipts or cancel, contact the practice (Hint is the processor, not the provider). Find DPC practices: DPC Frontier mapper https://mapper.dpcfrontier.com (3,208 mapped practices as of this check). MEDICARE: Direct primary care (DPC) practices usually do not bill insurance; to accept a DPC fee from a Medicare patient the physician typically must opt out of Medicare, so neither the DPC fee nor visits there are paid by Medicare, and the patient signs a private contract. The patient keeps Medicare (Part A/B/D and any Medigap/Advantage) for specialists, hospitals, labs and imaging outside the practice. Since 2026 (2025 law) DPC fees up to $150/month individual can be paid from an HSA, but people enrolled in Medicare cannot contribute to an HSA.

entries.notes: Masamts.com now redirects to masaaccess.com (rebranded 'Medical Access & Service Advantage'); member login remains https://www.masamts.com/member. Payment FAQ (one page used for pay, auto-renew setup and cancel): pay by bank account or credit card; monthly plans are deducted automatically every month; renew by logging in, by returning the mailed renewal notice with payment, or by phone 1-800-643-9023. Annual plans auto-renew only if the auto-renewal box was checked on the application; to change that, send the request in writing to the Member Services mail address or info@masaglobal.com. To change payment information, call 1-800-643-9023. Members send MASA the ambulance bill after insurance; MASA pays approved balances with any ambulance provider (no network). Guaranteed issue, no health questions. Sold heavily through in-person seminars and agents to older adults: compare cost against the actual out-of-pocket risk (Medicare Part B + Medigap usually leave little ambulance balance). MEDICARE: Part B covers medically necessary emergency ground ambulance (80% after the Part B deductible; non-emergency trips only with a doctor's certification). Federal No Surprises Act balance-billing protection does NOT apply to ground ambulances, which is what these subscriptions cover (some states have their own laws). Medicare does NOT pay or reimburse the subscription fee. Medicaid enrollees generally may not buy these subscriptions. To update billing information (card or bank account), log in to the member portal, email info@masaglobal.com, or call 1-800-643-9023 with your member number. Your member ID is on the welcome email and on your plan card.

entries.notes: Pay-per-visit; charged only after appointment time and payment info are confirmed. Full refund if cancelled 24+ hours ahead; late-cancel fees (e.g., $25 for wellness visits) per FAQ. Refund requests by phone. No membership fee. MEDICARE: Original Medicare pays for telehealth only from Medicare-enrolled providers, and home-based telehealth flexibilities have been extended by Congress in short increments (check current status); many Medicare Advantage plans include $0 or low-cost virtual visits, often delivered through Teladoc, Amwell or MDLIVE. Subscription/membership fees for telehealth services are never covered by Medicare. No subscription to cancel: you are charged per appointment. Cancel an appointment at least 24 hours ahead for a full refund. Health service specialists answer 24/7 at 1-800-400-6354.

entries.name: MDVIP (concierge primary care membership)
entries.service_area_detail: Network of affiliated concierge primary-care physicians nationwide
entries.senior_programs: Annual fee varies by physician and locale (look up via Find a Physician); payable annually, semi-annually or quarterly by card or check, or by automatic electronic bank debit. Fee is HSA/FSA/HRA-reimbursable after services are completed.
entries.notes: Four ways to pay (FAQ): Express Pay at /pay (no login), MDVIP Connect website (connect.mdvip.com), MDVIP Connect mobile app, or phone 866-696-3847. Automatic bank-account debit is available (FAQ page; same page for setup and to ask about stopping it). Prorated refund possible only if the wellness services were not yet performed. MEDICARE: Most concierge physicians stay enrolled in Medicare and bill Medicare/your Medigap or Advantage plan for covered visits, labs and tests as usual. The membership (retainer) fee pays for non-covered extras (longer annual wellness program, access, care coordination) and is NOT covered or reimbursed by Medicare, Medigap or Medicare Advantage. Medicare rules forbid charging the fee for Medicare-covered services themselves. Pay at mdvip.com/pay, MDVIP Connect (login.mdvip.com > Manage Payments; connect.mdvip.com redirects there) or app (Settings > Payment Methods), or 866-696-3847; quarterly/semi-annual/annual schedules; automatic checking/savings debit available. Prorated refund only if wellness services were not yet performed. FSA debit cards cannot pay the fee directly; reimbursement after services.

entries.name: Med-Trans membership (AirMedCare Network)
entries.service_area_detail: GMR air-ambulance brand; membership honored across AMCN providers (~320 bases in 38 states)
entries.phone_customer_service: Membership 800-793-0010; patient accounts 877-288-5340; AirMedCare Network site contact 833-819-3454
entries.mail_payment_address: AirMedCare Network, P.O. Box 948, West Plains, MO 65775
entries.senior_programs: $79/yr seniors over 60 (household); standard $99/yr.
entries.notes: CANCEL/BILLING: the AMCN support page (https://www.airmedcarenetwork.com/support) has a contact form with topics 'I would like to cancel my membership', 'I need to update my personal/billing info' and 'I need replacement membership cards'; member services also at https://www.airmedcarenetwork.com/member-services-guide and 833-819-3454. Brand-level pointer: this provider's membership IS an AirMedCare Network (AMCN) membership. Provider page states $99/yr per household, $79/yr for seniors over 60; new memberships start 15 days after completed application and payment. Membership questions: 800-793-0010 or amcn.questions@gmr.net (per Guardian Flight contact block). AMCN terms list 1/3/5/10-year terms and a MONTHLY option ($9/month standard or senior/affinity; $14.99 Fly-U-Home), so monthly members have a recurring charge; annual senior rate $79, 10-year senior $589. Memberships are non-refundable except state exceptions (e.g., Alaska 15-day withdrawal, Wyoming pro-rated cancellation). AMCN footer: alliance of Air Evac Lifeteam, Guardian Flight, Med-Trans and REACH. AMCN FAQ says Medicaid usually pays air ambulance in full and members certify they are not Medicaid beneficiaries. To cancel, use the AirMedCare Network Support page form or call. MEDICARE: Part B covers medically necessary emergency air ambulance (80% of the approved amount after the Part B deductible); Medigap or a Medicare Advantage plan usually covers most of the rest, and the federal No Surprises Act (2022) bars out-of-network air-ambulance balance billing for insured patients. Medicare does NOT pay for or reimburse the membership fee. Memberships are not insurance and Medicaid enrollees generally may not buy them. Confirm auto-renew status and cancel via the support form or 833-819-3454. Standard AMCN terms: memberships are non-refundable except state-specific rules (Wyoming 30-day full refund and pro-rated after; Alaska 15-day cancel window). Renew an existing membership on the AirMedCare Network 'Renew membership' page. The Support page (phone 833-819-3454; mail P.O. Box 948, West Plains, MO 65775) has a message form with topics for cancelling a membership, updating personal or billing information, and replacement cards. One membership covers everyone at the same primary residence, including students away at school; members 60+ get the senior household price and there is no annual cap on transports. Memberships are non-refundable and non-transferable. Medicaid usually pays air ambulance in full, so Medicaid enrollees generally do not need a membership.

entries.name: Medjet (MedjetAssist / MedjetHorizon) medical transport membership
entries.service_area_detail: US residents (not sold in Wyoming); covers hospital-to-hospital transport home when hospitalized 150+ miles from home, in the US or abroad
entries.senior_programs: Standard memberships to age 74; Diamond membership for ages 75-84 (one transport per year; https://medjetassist.com/diamond-membership); Platinum for 85+. MDVIP members get a discount (https://www.medjetassist.com/mdvip).
entries.notes: Renew at the Enroll page with ?isrenewal=1 or by phone; compare plans at https://medjetassist.com/membership-options; member services https://medjetassist.com/contacts (from abroad +1-205-595-6626). The FAQ does not describe auto-renewal or refunds; call to cancel. Not sold in Wyoming because of a 2019 state law. MEDICARE: Original Medicare generally does not cover care outside the U.S. and never pays for repatriation/medical transport home to a hospital of your choice; some Medigap plans (C, D, F, G, M, N) cover 80% of foreign emergency care up to a $50,000 lifetime limit, but not transport home. Medicare does not pay this membership fee. Short-term memberships start at 12:01 AM on the effective date and end at 11:59 PM on the expiration date, and must be bought before you leave home. Travelers up to age 75 (84 with the Diamond application) can buy expatriate plans for long stays abroad.

entries.notes: FAQ covers Auto Ship (choose SUBSCRIBE at checkout; the card on file is charged when each order processes; cancel anytime; the cancel cutoff is usually 5 PM Thursday for the next delivery) and paying with benefit cards. The site does not describe billing long-term care insurance or the VA directly. Veterans/LTC policyholders self-pay and seek reimbursement, or ask their VA/plan case manager whether an authorized meal benefit exists. Subscribe page: https://www.momsmeals.com/the-full-scoop/subscribe/. Auto Ship charges the card on file when each order processes; cancel any time; benefit cards accepted. FAQ: Auto Ship subscriptions charge the credit card on file when each order is processed, with a reminder email before each order; cancel any time; meal cancellations for the next delivery are typically needed by 5 PM Thursday. Health-plan food benefit cards (Solutran S3, OTC Network) are entered at checkout; card-branded benefit cards go in the credit card field.

entries.name: PHI Cares (PHI Air Medical membership)

entries.senior_programs: Automatic senior (60+) pricing: 1-yr $75 (std $95), 3-yr $193, 5-yr $293, 10-yr $585. Covers the whole household.
entries.notes: Renew online with membership number at /my-account/ or by phone; members get a renewal postcard one month before expiration (FAQ). 1, 3, 5 and 10-year terms (California limited to 12 months). Coverage starts 5 days after completed application and nonrefundable payment. No auto-renew terms published; no published cancel page (call). Covers PHI Air Medical only, not other air or ground providers. MEDICARE: Part B covers medically necessary emergency air ambulance (80% of the approved amount after the Part B deductible); Medigap or a Medicare Advantage plan usually covers most of the rest, and the federal No Surprises Act (2022) bars out-of-network air-ambulance balance billing for insured patients. Medicare does NOT pay for or reimburse the membership fee. Memberships are not insurance and Medicaid enrollees generally may not buy them. Members get a renewal postcard a month before expiration; renew online with membership number at phicares.com or pay by card at 1-888-435-9744 (M-F 6:00am-4:30pm MT). Payments are nonrefundable. No auto-renew or online cancel instructions are published. /login and /my-account now redirect to a Salesforce member site (phiairmedical.my.site.com). Memberships do not auto-renew: PHI Cares mails a renewal postcard one month before the expiration date; renew online with your membership number or call 1-888-435-9744 to pay by credit card. Membership starts 5 days after the completed application and payment; payments are nonrefundable. Medicaid members cannot enroll (federal law).

entries.name: Planet Fitness membership

entries.payment_processor: in-house / franchisee (monthly EFT from a checking account at many clubs; debit or credit card accepted for online payments)
entries.notes: The FAQ page answers billing, payment, cancel and annual-fee questions. Billing questions go to the home club; if the club is closed, contact Member Services (Mon-Fri 9am-6pm ET) at https://www.planetfitness.com/about-planet-fitness/contact-us. To END a membership: mail a letter to the home club, go to the club in person, or use the member portal online. The club must receive the request at least 8 days before the next billing date, and at least 8 days before the annual-fee date to stop that fee. A $58 buyout applies if a minimum term is ended early. Many clubs bill monthly by EFT from a checking account. Transfer between clubs: https://www.planetfitness.com/my-account/membership. Many clubs accept SilverSneakers or other Medicare Advantage fitness benefits; check with the home club. The only phone number on the page is the general counsel line (603-750-0001), which is not for billing.

Subscription/membership fees for telehealth services are never covered by Medicare. PlushCare is out of network with Medicaid; non-medical phone 1-800-221-5140. The membership page shows $19.99/month with the first month free and lets you cancel anytime; if PlushCare cannot treat you the visit is refunded in full.

entries.name: REACH Air Medical Services membership (AirMedCare Network)
entries.service_area_detail: GMR air-ambulance brand; membership honored across AMCN providers (~320 bases in 38 states)
entries.phone_customer_service: Membership 800-793-0010; administration 707-324-2400; AirMedCare Network site contact 833-819-3454
entries.mail_payment_address: AirMedCare Network, P.O. Box 948, West Plains, MO 65775
entries.senior_programs: $79/yr seniors over 60 (household); standard $99/yr.
entries.notes: CANCEL/BILLING: the AMCN support page (https://www.airmedcarenetwork.com/support) has a contact form with topics 'I would like to cancel my membership', 'I need to update my personal/billing info' and 'I need replacement membership cards'; member services also at https://www.airmedcarenetwork.com/member-services-guide and 833-819-3454. Brand-level pointer: this provider's membership IS an AirMedCare Network (AMCN) membership. Provider page states $99/yr per household, $79/yr for seniors over 60; new memberships start 15 days after completed application and payment. Membership questions: 800-793-0010 or amcn.questions@gmr.net (per Guardian Flight contact block). AMCN terms list 1/3/5/10-year terms and a MONTHLY option ($9/month standard or senior/affinity; $14.99 Fly-U-Home), so monthly members have a recurring charge; annual senior rate $79, 10-year senior $589. Memberships are non-refundable except state exceptions (e.g., Alaska 15-day withdrawal, Wyoming pro-rated cancellation). AMCN footer: alliance of Air Evac Lifeteam, Guardian Flight, Med-Trans and REACH. AMCN FAQ says Medicaid usually pays air ambulance in full and members certify they are not Medicaid beneficiaries. To cancel, use the AirMedCare Network Support page form or call. MEDICARE: Part B covers medically necessary emergency air ambulance (80% of the approved amount after the Part B deductible); Medigap or a Medicare Advantage plan usually covers most of the rest, and the federal No Surprises Act (2022) bars out-of-network air-ambulance balance billing for insured patients. Medicare does NOT pay for or reimburse the membership fee. Memberships are not insurance and Medicaid enrollees generally may not buy them. Confirm auto-renew status and cancel via the support form or 833-819-3454. Standard AMCN terms: memberships are non-refundable except state-specific rules (Wyoming 30-day full refund and pro-rated after; Alaska 15-day cancel window). Renew an existing membership on the AirMedCare Network 'Renew membership' page. The Support page (phone 833-819-3454; mail P.O. Box 948, West Plains, MO 65775) has a message form with topics for cancelling a membership, updating personal or billing information, and replacement cards. One membership covers everyone at the same primary residence, including students away at school; members 60+ get the senior household price and there is no annual cap on transports. Memberships are non-refundable and non-transferable. Medicaid usually pays air ambulance in full, so Medicaid enrollees generally do not need a membership.

entries.name: SingleCare prescription savings

entries.phone_customer_service: 844-234-3057 (24/7 except major holidays); support@singlecare.com
entries.notes: Help page: SingleCare is a FREE prescription discount card; there is no membership fee or recurring bill. If a senior sees a 'SingleCare' charge it is the pharmacy price paid at the counter, not a subscription. MEDICARE: A discount card or Rx membership price cannot be combined with Medicare Part D on the same prescription. Paying cash with a discount usually does not count toward the Part D deductible or the 2026 out-of-pocket cap ($2,100) unless the pharmacy submits it to the plan, so compare the cash price with the Part D copay. The membership fee itself is not covered by Medicare. "membership is totally free" and SingleCare never charges for its service, so there is no recurring bill; kept only so the app can tell seniors no payment is due. Member center: https://www.singlecare.com/member-center.

entries.name: Talkspace online therapy subscription
entries.service_area_detail: Nationwide
entries.payment_processor: Stripe (card on file; optional Stripe Link)
entries.senior_programs: Medicare: Talkspace therapy is covered by Original Medicare Part B and Medicare Advantage in all 50 states + DC (psychiatry not covered by Original Medicare); Part B deductible/20% coinsurance apply, Medigap claims are forwarded. Out-of-pocket subscribers can pause a plan for 7 days instead of cancelling.
entries.notes: Monthly online-therapy subscriptions. Talkspace advertises insurance coverage, including some Medicare plans. MEDICARE: Medicare Part B covers some telehealth visits from Medicare-enrolled clinicians, but cash-pay app memberships and subscription fees are not covered or reimbursed; using a discount card instead of Part D means the purchase does not count toward your Part D out-of-pocket cap. Out-of-pocket therapy plans bill automatically on the signup day each cycle with an email reminder a few days before renewal; auto-billing of invoices cannot be disabled; billing history and invoices under Account > Transactions; superbills available for out-of-network reimbursement. Cancel anytime in account settings; no refunds. MEDICARE: unlike most memberships here, Talkspace THERAPY is billed to Original Medicare Part B / Medicare Advantage, so a senior should sign up through the insurance path rather than paying the cash subscription. No phone support published.

entries.mail_payment_address: Teladoc Health, 155 East 44th Street, Suite 1700, New York, NY 10017 (corporate)
entries.senior_programs: General Medical visit $89 without insurance; as low as $0 with plan benefits. Works with many Medicare Advantage and Medicaid managed-care plans.
entries.notes: Teladoc does not sell a standalone consumer membership; charges are per visit (fee shown before confirming the visit) or through the sponsoring plan/employer (which may bill a monthly access fee on the employer side). FAQ 'Billing and insurance' section covers costs. Teladoc is NOT a provider for Original (fee-for-service) Medicare or fee-for-service Medicaid. Its BetterHelp therapy and BetterSleep products are separate subscriptions. MEDICARE: Original Medicare pays for telehealth only from Medicare-enrolled providers, and home-based telehealth flexibilities have been extended by Congress in short increments (check current status); many Medicare Advantage plans include $0 or low-cost virtual visits, often delivered through Teladoc, Amwell or MDLIVE. Subscription/membership fees for telehealth services are never covered by Medicare. Account info FAQs: you are asked for billing information only when a visit fee is due; update the card on file any time in your account. If you are not covered through insurance or an employer you can still use Teladoc at a flat rate per visit. Cancel a scheduled visit with the 'Cancel Visit' button on the website or app.

entries.service_area_detail: City of Franklin; calendar year
entries.senior_programs: $60 per year covers everyone listed at the address.
entries.notes: Renew each year (Jan 1 - Dec 31). MEDICARE: Part B covers medically necessary emergency ground ambulance (80% of the approved amount after the Part B deductible; non-emergency trips only with a doctor's certification); Medigap usually pays the 20%. The federal No Surprises Act does NOT protect against ground-ambulance balance bills. Medicare, Medigap and Medicare Advantage do NOT pay or reimburse the subscription fee itself; a subscription mainly helps people with no Medigap, high Advantage copays, or trips Medicare denies. Medicaid enrollees generally cannot or need not join. Applications can be picked up at Franklin Fire and Rescue (100 S Main Street) or Hunterdale Volunteer Fire Department (201 Delaware Road), or emailed to you on request from the Secretary of Emergency Services.

entries.name: PartnerMD (concierge medicine, VA/SC/GA/NC/MD etc.)
entries.service_area_detail: Concierge primary care practices (Richmond VA headquarters); check site for current locations
entries.mail_payment_address: PartnerMD, 7001 Forest Avenue, Suite 302, Richmond, VA 23230
entries.senior_programs: Membership billed monthly, quarterly, semi-annually or annually; cancel anytime with 30 days' notice; referral credit 20% off next renewal.
entries.notes: Pricing page has the fee estimator, billing frequency options and the 30-day cancellation rule. Accepts Medicare and most insurance for covered medical services; the membership fee is separate. MEDICARE: Most concierge physicians stay enrolled in Medicare and bill Medicare/your Medigap or Advantage plan for covered visits, labs and tests as usual. The membership (retainer) fee pays for non-covered extras (longer annual wellness program, access, care coordination) and is NOT covered or reimbursed by Medicare, Medigap or Medicare Advantage. Medicare rules forbid charging the fee for Medicare-covered services themselves. Members FAQ: membership can be paid by check, credit card or automatic bank draft; billing can be annual, semi-annual, quarterly or monthly (to change the cycle or payment method email Membership Billing at billing@partnermd.com). The Patient Portal is for medical-service bills only (Billing & Payments shows transaction history); membership billing is a separate department. Part of the membership fee and health-coaching receipts may be FSA/HSA reimbursable. Referral program: refer five people outside your household who join and next year's membership is free.

entries.name: Airlift Northwest Membership (UW Medicine air ambulance; WA and Southeast AK)
entries.service_area_detail: Residents of Washington and Southeast Alaska (8 bases)
entries.phone_customer_service: 888-835-1599; membership@airliftnw.org / alnwmembership@uw.edu
entries.senior_programs: $85 for one year or $160 for two years per household; $65 for hospital staff/EMS.
entries.notes: Membership page: covers the patient-responsibility amount on the insurer's EOB for emergency/medically necessary Airlift Northwest flights; only the insurer is billed. All household members must have insurance with air-ambulance benefits. Active immediately on application and payment. AUTO-RENEW: FAQ says automatic renewal is not yet available (renew each year online or by phone). Membership card is printed on the receipt; check expiration by looking up the account on the membership page or calling. Montana residents eligible only with a WA/AK residence. Medicaid enrollees are not billed a balance and do not need a membership. MEDICARE: Part B covers medically necessary emergency air ambulance (80% of the approved amount after the Part B deductible); Medigap or a Medicare Advantage plan usually covers most of the rest, and the federal No Surprises Act (2022) bars out-of-network air-ambulance balance billing for insured patients. Medicare does NOT pay for or reimburse the membership fee. Memberships are not insurance and Medicaid enrollees generally may not buy them.
